name: City Horizon Carousel Runtime Camera Contract
purpose: Bind carousel authoring to the City Horizon classic-tycoon camera contract and to the same runtime world-to-screen implementation used by the game.

visualCamera.visualReference: classic late-1990s/early-2000s tycoon read, including Zoo Tycoon 1

authoringRule: Runtime parity alone is not sufficient. Export QA must also prove CH_CAMERA_V1 geometry: 2:1 dimetric ground, 26.565-degree screen axes, 45-degree yaw, 30-degree orthographic elevation and no perspective.
